seoTitle: Image Extractor from HTML: img, srcset, og:image, CSS, Alt Check
metaDescription: Find every image reference in pasted HTML: img, srcset, picture sources, og:image, icons, posters, CSS backgrounds and JSON-LD, with alt and size flags.
intro: List all images a page references and spot missing alt text, missing dimensions and lazy-loading gaps.
why:
Images drive both SEO and layout shift. This tool lists every image reference in pasted HTML: img tags with alt text, srcset and picture candidates, og:image and twitter:image, icons, video posters, CSS background URLs and JSON-LD images. For img tags it flags missing alt attributes, empty alt (fine only for decorative images), missing width and height (a cause of layout shift) and absent loading="lazy".

It cannot download or measure files, because a web page cannot fetch other sites. Open or save the URLs yourself, or use the Image SEO audit for on-page rules.
howTo: Paste the page HTML and the page URL.
Fix the flagged images and copy the URL list.

faq.a: No, downloads from other sites are blocked in a web page. It lists the URLs.

faq.q: Why flag missing width and height?
faq.a: Without them the browser cannot reserve space and the page shifts when images load.

faq.q: Does the first image need lazy loading?
faq.a: No. Lazy loading the main hero image slows the largest contentful paint.
